Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
If i take an action with smudge, get blocked by a sniper rifle carrying minion and tap ohoyo for her special text, the sniper rifle may be used in the resulting combat to set range or not?

Remnant of the elder storm rushes, i tap ohoyo, remnant may not rush again, correct?

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Ohoyo Hopoksia (Bastet)
Cardtype: Ally
Clan: Ahrimane
Cost: 3 pool
Unique werewolf with 3 life. 3 strength, 0 bleed.
When a minion you control is about to enter combat with an acting minion, you may tap Ohoyo to cancel that combat; Ohoyo enters combat with the acting minion instead. She gets an optional maneuver each combat. If she has less than 3 life during your untap phase, she gains 1 life from the blood bank.

Ohoyo is tapped when you block, not when you are blocked (that's "Slave").
Answer is: No, the minion with the Sniper Rifle cannot set the range in that non-resulting combat.

When Remnant rushes and Ohoyo is tapped, the action resolves. NRA applies to Remnant, who can't perform its built-in rush action for this turn.
